qualification.education_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course with GATE/NET
qualification.details: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship and GATE.; Selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. | Desirable: | B.Tech /M.Tech/ M.Sc. in Material Science/Metallurgy and Materials Engg./Polymer Tech. or Engg./Nanosci. & Nanotech./ Mechanical Engg/ Chemical Engg./Chemistry/ Physics/ Applied Physics/ Applied Science/ E&I/ Instrumentation and Control/Energy Science with valid/qualified GATE/NET rank. Knowledge of electrochemical studies related to battery and nanocomposite material synthesis.

how_to_apply: Candidates desiring to appear for the Interview should submit their applications with CV, Degree Certificates, Experience Certificates, Publications, and Aadhar Card through email by 10/11/2026.
Submit your application via email to: [email protected].
important_instructions: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply. Candidate shall bring along with them the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship and GATE.; Selection process through National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MOE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISC, IISER, NISER etc. Desirable: B.Tech /M.Tech/ M.Sc. in Material Science/Metallurgy and Materials Engg./Polymer Tech. or Engg./Nanosci. & Nanotech./ Mechanical Engg/ Chemical Engg./Chemistry/ Physics/ Applied Physics/ Applied Science/ E&I/ Instrumentation and Control/Energy Science with valid/qualified GATE/NET rank. Knowledge of electrochemical studies related to battery and nanocomposite material synthesis.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Duration: 1 Years 9 Months The selected candidate may get an opportunity for PhD admission.

content_sections.heading: How Will IIT Roorkee Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Application screening Interview Interview of shortlisted candidates; no TA/DA is admissible for attending it. Preference to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: CV Degree Certificates Experience Certificates Publications Aadhar Card

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Candidates desiring to appear for the Interview should submit their applications with CV, Degree Certificates, Experience Certificates, Publications, and Aadhar Card through email by 10/11/2026. Submit your application via email to: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply. Candidate shall bring along with them the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification.
